the same algebra at three loci: system cosmic share -> f_c = f_ret; A44 -> f_c = 1; A43's EOS reading -> f_c = 2.195

checks.what: symbol ledger: CFG804's N = 1/f_ret (cold mass 5.364 N M_b) and A44's N = R_cosmic/f_ret (cold mass N M_b) are the SAME model, a factor 5.364 apart
A44's two numbers reproduce from the definitions: 53.643 = 5.364/0.10, r_e = sqrt(N(N+1)) r_M = 54.14 r_M = 0.32-0.75 Mpc (A44 quotes 0.19-0.75; the 0.19 end belongs to its N=15.9 edge, not to 53.64)
the factor 10 is NOT a density: at r_e the cold medium is 133 x the cosmic cold density, at 0.1 Mpc ~6e3 x, and r200 is 200 x the mean matter density by definition

cosmic-mean availability: only 18% (13.5% inside the zero-velocity sphere) of the budget is there at the present cosmic mean density; the other 82% is the catchment's turnaround overdensity (1/fraction = 5.55 = Delta_ta), i.e. the cold sector must trace the matter
checks.measured: mean-density cold mass inside r_ta = 0.180 of 53.64 M_b, inside r_ZV = 0.135; r_needed at mean density = 3.37 Mpc = 1.95 r_ZV

checks.what: escape velocity: v_esc/v_H = 6 and v_esc/sigma_c = 32 at r_e, and the ambient-infall capacity v^2 r/G at r_e is 2.6x the budget -- this bound does not bite
tidal field: an equal-mass neighbour must sit beyond 0.95 Mpc (53.64 model) or 0.68 Mpc (self-consistent N=38); a 10x neighbour beyond 2.0 Mpc

phase space: the coarse-grained density implies a Tremaine-Gunn floor m >= 37 eV (no new obstruction), and the sector's own sigma_c could hold only 0.2% of the mass at r_e -- the binding is the total mass, not the sector's dispersion
checks.measured: rho(r_e)=3.01e-28 g/cm^3, Q=3.30e-47, m_TG=37 eV, sigma_c^2 r_e/G=1.1e+10 Msun (0.20% of M_tot)

checks.what: the CFG416 fixed point exists, is unique, and reproduces A18's grid (44.125 at 1e11, 14.917 at 1e12); per bin N = 53.64, 53.64, 50.3, 37.9
AVAILABILITY vs REQUIREMENT: the smallest available budget (37.9 M_b at the top bin) is 2.4x the N the data require (15.9), so availability does NOT cap below the requirement
the available budget fits: dchi2(primary) at N=44.1 is <= +1 (A44's 53.64 gives +1.1, N_req=15.9 gives +4); the per-bin CFG804 model gives -0.3
the factor 10 is the LOW-MASS branch: f_ret = 0.10 is the table's value only while M_ta <= 1e12.5 Msun/h, i.e. M_b <= 7.4e10; at 1e11 it is 44.1 (82%), at the top bin 37.9 (71%)

u: A18's u = R_tot/N = 0.467 and A29's u_MID = 0.472 are numerically the same to 0.1 sigma but are different functionals (3D budget fraction vs projected band ratio); u <= 1 never constrained f_ret -- it bounds the law's share of the budget
geometry: the edge is 1.4-1.8 r200c and 0.3-0.4 r_ta -- inside the catchment; the geometric cap is N <= 155, three times the f_ret cap, so the baryon budget binds first

N.meaning: cold mass per system baryon = R_cosmic/f_ret^b
